monsters.name: Soot Wraith Wisp
monsters.flavour: A curl of smoke that has decided to have elbows, and to use them.

monsters.name: Soot Wraith Drifter
monsters.flavour: It drifts along the roof girders, well out of reach of anything you can swing.

monsters.name: Soot Wraith Billow
monsters.flavour: A thick grey billow that a blade passes straight through and a spark sets crackling.

monsters.name: Soot Wraith Overman
monsters.flavour: It stands over the hottest furnace as if it ran the shift, and hits like it.

monsters.name: Old Bellows
monsters.flavour: The Foundry's oldest bellows, patched with every century's leather, and still pumping when the shift has gone home.
